name: region
title: Board region
description: The frame of one area of the board, an open frame with no fill (D-024): its title and decided count sit in a gap cut from the top border on the left, the layout-mode buttons and Reset places in a gap on the right, all drawn as one generic element whatever the mode. Cards and wires are drawn in their own layers (D-013), so the element is only the frame.

files.core: region-core.ts (regionState, regionHolders, regionColour, REGION_COLOUR_DEFAULT, MODE_LABEL, RegionState, RegionHolder; no DOM)
files.template: region-template.ts (regionTemplate and holdersTemplate: the only places the markup is built)
files.styles: region.css (scoped by the tag; tokens only; the top padding states REGION_HEAD from packages/layout)

flaggedStates.held: agentAccess flag: the region's holders after the count, the creator as plain text and every other holder as a Remove access button (D-027). Kept out of `states` so the gallery without the flag reads as before.

attributes.data-mode: grid | flow | lanes | radial | list: the layout in force (set by update)
attributes.--region: the frame colour as a CSS value, from regionColour (set by render); the frame line and the title mix from it
attributes.aria-labelledby: region-<id>, the heading inside the frame (set by render)

methods.render(r: Region): once per view version: data-region, role, aria-labelledby, --region, innerHTML = regionTemplate(r)
methods.update(st: RegionState): on every state change: attributes and text only (data-mode, mode button aria-pressed, count text, Reset places and the empty message shown or hidden), so focus survives; the holders slot is redrawn from holdersTemplate only when the holders change

events: button[data-mode] click bubbles to the page's delegated listener -> the mode action
button[data-reset] click bubbles to the page's delegated listener -> unpin every node of the region
button[data-revoke] click bubbles to the page's delegated listener -> confirm, then the revoke action for that holder (agentAccess flag)
whenToUse: The frame of every area of the board that has its own layout mode.
whenNotToUse: Lane bands and labels inside a region (the wires layer draws them until <vb-link> arrives); cards (<vb-node>).
narrow: Under 480px (container query) only the pressed mode button shows; the group opens on hover or keyboard focus. Stage 2d replaces the buttons with the icon row.
accessibility: A labelled region landmark named by its heading. The mode buttons are real buttons in a labelled group with aria-pressed; Reset places is a real button, hidden when there is nothing to reset. A removable holder is a real button named "<label>: remove access"; the creator is plain text.
